method: Each commit created by GitHub's web 'Commit suggestions' action (single or batched) was fetched into a local clone. The expected bytes are the parent commit's blob with exactly the suggested line(s) replaced by the suggestion payload plus LF; the actual bytes are `git show <commit>:<path>`. Both are compared byte for byte and by Git blob id (`git hash-object --stdin` vs `git rev-parse <commit>:<path>`). Independently, each file was read through the contents API with the raw media type at the applied commit (the approved gh-file read tool); `apiRawReadBlob` is `git hash-object` of those bytes and `apiRawReadMatchesGit` reports a byte-for-byte comparison with `git show`.
